startup.title: Startup
startup.changeFailed: The setting could not be changed.

openAtLogin.title: Open at login
openAtLogin.description: Open CompressO automatically when you log in to your computer.

needsApproval.title: Turned off in System Settings
needsApproval.description: CompressO is not allowed to open at login. Allow it in System Settings, under General and Login Items.

openInTrayOnly.title_macos: Open in the menu bar only
openInTrayOnly.title_windows: Open in the system tray only
openInTrayOnly.description_macos: Do not show the main window when opened at login. Media can still be compressed from the menu bar.
openInTrayOnly.description_windows: Do not show the main window when opened at login. Media can still be compressed from the system tray.
openInTrayOnly.needsTrayIcon_macos: Turn on Show menu bar icon to use this, as the app is opened from there.
openInTrayOnly.needsTrayIcon_windows: Turn on Show system tray icon to use this, as the app is opened from there.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Switch between the light and dark interface.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Color used for buttons, highlights and progress.

tintedWindow.title: Tinted window
tintedWindow.description: Let the desktop show softly through the window background.

tintOpacity.title: Tint opacity
tintOpacity.description: How much of the desktop shows through. Lower values show more of it.

showIcon.description_macos: Show the CompressO icon, the compression progress and the drop zone in the menu bar.
showIcon.description_windows: Show the CompressO icon, the compression progress and the drop zone in the system tray.
showIcon.locked: Media in the drop zone is being compressed. This can be turned off once it is done or stopped.

videoPreviews.title: Video previews
videoPreviews.description: Play videos inside the app. Videos do not play well on some Linux systems, so a still image is shown instead by default. Changes apply after a restart.

preventSleep.title: Prevent sleep while compressing
preventSleep.description: Keep the computer awake until the compression is done. The screen can still turn off. Closing the lid still puts it to sleep.

keepScreenOn.title: Keep the screen on
keepScreenOn.description: Also keep the screen from turning off while compressing.

completionSound.title: Completion sound
completionSound.description: Play a sound when a compression completes.

logFiles.title: Log files
logFiles.description: A record of what the app did, which helps find the cause of a problem. Include them when reporting one. They contain the names of the files you compressed.
logFiles.failed: The log files could not be shown.

presets.isDefault_video: Default for new videos. Select to use the Standard preset instead.
presets.isDefault_image: Default for new images. Select to use the Standard preset instead.
presets.isDefault_audio: Default for new audio files. Select to use the Standard preset instead.
presets.setDefault_video: Set as default for new videos
presets.setDefault_image: Set as default for new images
presets.setDefault_audio: Set as default for new audio files
presets.name: Preset name
presets.empty_video: There are no video presets yet. Adjust the settings of a video and select the plus button next to the Preset menu to save them as a preset.
presets.empty_image: There are no image presets yet. Adjust the settings of an image and select the plus button next to the Preset menu to save them as a preset.
presets.empty_audio: There are no audio presets yet. Adjust the settings of an audio file and select the plus button next to the Preset menu to save them as a preset.

dropZone.needsTrayIcon_macos: The drop zone is in the menu bar, so it only works when Show menu bar icon is turned on in General.
dropZone.needsTrayIcon_windows: The drop zone is in the system tray, so it only works when Show system tray icon is turned on in General.
dropZone.turnOnTrayIcon_macos: The drop zone is in the menu bar. Turn on Show menu bar icon in General first.
dropZone.turnOnTrayIcon_windows: The drop zone is in the system tray. Turn on Show system tray icon in General first.

autoCompress.title: Compress automatically
autoCompress.description: Compress media as soon as it is added to the drop zone, one at a time, and save it to the save location of Output.
autoCompress.needsSaveLocation: Choose a save location in Output, other than Ask every time, so the compressed media can be saved without asking.

watch.title: Watch clipboard
watch.description_macos: Add media you copy, such as files or images from a browser, to the drop zone in the menu bar.
watch.description_windows: Add media you copy, such as files or images from a browser, to the drop zone in the system tray.

location.title: Save location
location.description_ask: Choose where to save after each compression.
location.description_fixedFolder: Save automatically to the chosen folder after each compression.
location.description_sameFolder: Save automatically next to the original file, in the same folder.

folder.title: Folder
folder.dialogTitle: Choose a folder to save compressed media to.

preserveFolders.title: Preserve folder structure
preserveFolders.description: Save the files of a dropped folder in the same folders. When off, all files are saved in one folder, and files with the same name are numbered.

skipLarger.title: Skip larger outputs
skipLarger.description: Do not save the compressed media when it is larger than the original.

prefix.title: File name prefix
prefix.description: Text added to the start of saved file names. Leave empty to keep the original names.

copyOutput.title: Copy output to clipboard
copyOutput.description: Copy the compressed media to the clipboard after each compression, so it can be pasted right away.

includeBatch.title: Include batch outputs
includeBatch.description: Also copy the files when several are compressed at once.

hardwareAcceleration.title: Use hardware acceleration
hardwareAcceleration.description: Compress videos faster with hardware acceleration (Files can be slightly larger)
hardwareAcceleration.unavailable: Hardware acceleration is not available on this computer.

clearCache.title: Clear cache
clearCache.description: Free up space by deleting temporary files. Your saved files are not affected.
clearCache.mediaOpen: Close the media you are working on first, as it uses the cache.
clearCache.failed: There was a problem clearing cache.
